children: Artisan Partners reported preliminary assets under management of $183.5 billion as of August 31, 2026, and disclosed a planned ~$6 billion rebalancing from its Global Value strategy.
Preliminary firm AUM totaled $183.5 billion as of Aug. 31, 2026, per press release.
Artisan Funds and Artisan Global Funds account for $94.5 billion of total AUM.
Separate accounts and other AUM comprise $89.0 billion of firm AUM.
A long-standing sub-advisory client will shift to a multi-manager structure, rebalancing about $6 billion from Global Value in Sept. 2026.
Revenue impact is expected to be smaller than the AUM reduction due to the mandate's fee structure.
